scripts.build: npm run catalog && tsc -b && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && vite build
scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/verify-levels.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/verify-groove.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/verify-styles.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/verify-scenery.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/verify-ratings.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/verify-gameplay.mjs && npm run test:online
scripts.db:local: npm run catalog && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && npm run ratings:admin -- init --local
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env '' && npm run ratings:admin -- init && wrangler deploy --env ''
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env preview && npm run ratings:admin -- init --preview && wrangler deploy --env preview
